data.name: Integrated Extinguishers
data.description: Integrated Extinguishers is a Booster in Helldivers 2. When equipped, it reduces the amount of time to extinguish flames when any Helldiver squad member is lit on fire.
data.effect: Equips Helldiver uniforms with form-fitting, automated, rapid-response fire suppression systems. Significantly reduces the time it takes to naturally extinguish flames without conducting ground-aided smothering manuevers.
